title: Deep-learning flux inference distinguished pancreatic cancer metabolic subtypes
summary: Across independent patient cohorts, the study identified glycolytic and lipogenic transcription-factor-defined pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma subtypes with distinct predicted metabolic programs and prognostic associations. TP63 knockdown shifted cell-line metabolic features, including reduced lactate and increased lipid droplets. scFEA fluxes are model predictions rather than direct intracellular measurements; cell-line perturbations do not establish clinical causality or treatment benefit.
ai_technology: scFEA deep neural network for metabolic flux inference
